# Business case: RepairLog

## Pricing
One plan: 59 PLN/month per shop, unlimited bikes, SMS pickup reminders included (up to 200 SMS/month).
Price tested in E-1 (F-3).

## Scenarios (month 6)
| | low | base | high |
|---|---|---|---|
| paying shops | 15 | 40 | 80 |
| revenue (PLN) | 885 | 2,360 | 4,720 |

Break-even at 25 shops against 1,450 PLN/month fixed and variable costs.
